items.stem: On a power-interest grid, how should you treat a stakeholder with high power but low interest?

options.text: Keep them satisfied with concise, relevant updates
options.rationale: Correct: high-power, low-interest stakeholders should be kept satisfied without overload.

options.text: Ignore them until the project ends
options.rationale: High power means they can still derail the work.

options.text: Involve them in every detailed decision
Treat them the same as low-power, low-interest
options.rationale: Their power demands more attention than minimal monitoring.

items.explanation: Correct: high-power, low-interest stakeholders should be kept satisfied without overload.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A department head opposes a change. Which TWO actions best address the resistance? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Uncover the underlying concern behind the opposition
options.rationale: Correct: understanding the real driver lets you address it.

options.text: Involve them early in shaping the rollout
options.rationale: Correct: involvement builds ownership and reduces resistance.

options.text: Escalate immediately to have them overruled
Stop communicating with them to avoid conflict
options.rationale: Silence erodes trust and leaves the concern unresolved.

items.explanation: Correct: understand the concern and involve them.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Why should a stakeholder map be revisited during a project rather than made only at the start?

options.text: Stakeholders, their influence and attitudes change over time
options.rationale: Correct: the map must track shifting power, interest and attitude.

options.text: The first map is always wrong
options.rationale: The point is change over time, not initial error.

options.text: Mapping is only a documentation requirement
options.rationale: It is an active management tool, not paperwork.

options.text: To increase the number of stakeholders listed
options.rationale: Re-assessment is about accuracy, not length.

items.explanation: Correct: the map must track shifting power, interest and attitude.
